title: Around the House
intro: What can we find around the house?

parentTip.vi: Lúc đánh răng, hỏi con "Where is your toothbrush? Where is the toothpaste?"

chat.ask: Do you brush your teeth every day?
chat.yes: Great! Clean teeth are happy teeth!
chat.no: Let's brush them now! Brush, brush!

text.title: Bedtime
lines: At eight o'clock, Max goes up the stairs.
He has a bath and uses a big towel.
Then he brushes his teeth with his blue toothbrush.
He gets into bed under his warm blanket. Good night, Max!
